> 第12章 混沌空间（第1页）
陆沉经历过炼体境，无须再炼体，再好的炼体丹对他也不起作用，还不如拿去收买人心。
“中品炼体丹很值钱的，你又不是有钱人。”
婉儿看了陆沉一眼，陆家主离开之后，陆沉过得并不怎么好。
因为，陆家财权掌握在陆正宁手上，经常克扣陆沉的月俸。
即使陆沉当少主，手上也没多少积蓄，日子过得勉勉强强。
“中品炼体丹在我眼里，一文不值！”
陆沉一摆手，正色说道，“婉儿，这些年你跟着我，吃了不少苦头，难为你了。我们很快会有钱，会有很多的钱，到时侯我找几十个丫环伺侯你。”
“婉儿不要别人伺侯，婉儿只想伺侯少主。”
陆沉看着婉儿，又说道，“中品炼体丹的药力很大，你回去之后，马上运功，好好吸收，说不准突破一个小境界呢。”
其实，婉儿是有修为的，炼体境一重。
只不过，她地位低微，没修炼资源，也没有变强的野心，境界一直没有进展。
要不是她的境界太低，体魄不强，不能服用太多的丹药，陆沉会把一百枚中品炼体丹全给她。
打发婉儿回去，陆沉却没有回自己的房间，而是去了偏僻的后山。
在后山，陆沉没有修炼，而是干别的事：搜索记忆。
在上千上万的残缺记忆中，有的过于残缺，只剩下一些碎片，没有任何价值。
但还有许多残缺记忆非碎片的存在，只是缺少一部分，或者大部分，虽然不完整，但存在一定价值。
陆沉想从这些仍有价值的残缺记忆中，找一门适合自己的战技。
武道界的功法和战技，分为天、地、玄、黄四个等级。

陆沉之前用的是回风拳，黄阶中品战技，已是陆家所收藏的最高战技。
陆沉现在修炼的是九龙归一诀，也不知是什么等级的功法，灵气强横，霸道无比。
而回风拳等级太低，完全跟不上节奏，既发挥不出九龙归一诀的最大威力，也不能给自身力量带来增幅，必须换掉。
在一大堆残缺的战技记忆中，陆沉竟然找到为数不少的强大战技。
最低的是玄阶，最高的竟然有天阶！
天刚拳，玄阶上品战技，缺少大部分记忆，价值太低，不可用。
太阴掌，地阶下品战技，缺少一半记忆，五成价值，可考虑。
九臂大拿手，地阶上品战技，缺少部分记忆，六成价值，可考虑。
斩天，天阶上品刀法，缺少后面三分一记忆，价值高，未来可用！
断月，天阶中品剑法，缺少后面四分一记忆，价值高，未来可用！
穿日，天阶中品箭法，缺少前面三分一记忆，无价值，不可用！
这些战技随便拿一门出去，哪怕是残缺的，也能震动整个双木城。
双木城最高的一门战技仅是黄阶上品，还是城主府的收藏，其他大家族顶多有黄阶中品而已。
最后，一门尚有八成记忆战技，吸引了陆沉的注意力。
炎阳指，地阶上品战技，缺少后面五分一记忆，八成价值，可用！
若是天阶战技，以陆沉目前的修为，根本没有力量去催动。
至于地阶战技，估计也悬，即使勉强催动，也会很吃力。
最好是玄阶战技，可惜玄阶战技比较少，没有多少合适陆沉的。
陆沉也没什么选择，只能寄望九龙归一诀，能够催动这门地阶战技。
不然的话，没有一门适合的战技，不能让自身力量增幅，会失去不少优势。

Lu Chen's latest chapter_Chapter 12 Chaos Space Page 1_Lu Chen Mo Feng Lie_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 12 Chaos Space (Page 1)
Lu Chen has experienced the body refining realm, and there is no need to refining the body. No matter how good the body refining pill is, it will not work on him. It is better to use it to win people's hearts.
"The middle-grade body refining pill is very valuable, and you are not a rich person."
Wan'er glanced at Lu Chen. After the head of the Lu family left, Lu Chen's life was not very good.
Because the financial power of the Lu family is in the hands of Lu Zhengning, Lu Chen's monthly salary is often deducted.
Even though Lu Chen was the young master, he didn't have much savings and could barely live a life.
"The middle-grade body refining pill is worthless in my eyes!"
Lu Chen waved his hand and said seriously, "Wan'er, you have followed me these years and suffered a lot. I have made it difficult for you. We will soon have money, a lot of money, and then I will find dozens of maids to serve you."
"Wan'er doesn't want anyone else to serve you, Wan'er just wants to serve young master Hou."
Lu Chen looked at Wan'er and said, "The middle-grade body refining pill is very powerful. After you go back, exercise your power immediately and absorb it well. You may be able to break through to a small level."
In fact, Wan'er has some cultivation and is at the first level of body refining realm.
However, her status is low, she has no cultivation resources, and no ambition to become stronger, so her realm has not progressed.
If her realm was not too low, her body was not strong, and she could not take too many pills, Lu Chen would have given her all 100 middle-grade body refining pills.
After sending Wan'er back, Lu Chen did not go back to his room, but went to the remote back mountain.
In the back mountain, Lu Chen did not practice, but did something else: search for memories.
Among the thousands of incomplete memories, some are so incomplete that only fragments remain, without any value.
But there are still many incomplete memories that are not fragments. They are just missing part or most of them. Although they are incomplete, they have certain value.
Lu Chen wanted to find a suitable combat skill from these incomplete memories that were still valuable.
The martial arts world's martial arts and combat skills are divided into four levels: heaven, earth, Xuan, and Huang.
Lu Chen used to use Hui Feng Fist, a middle-level yellow-level combat skill, which is already the highest combat skill in the Lu family's collection.
Lu Chen is currently practicing the Nine Dragons Returning to One Technique. He doesn't know what level of the technique it is. The spiritual energy is powerful and domineering.
The level of Huifeng Fist is too low and cannot keep up with the rhythm. It cannot exert the maximum power of Jiulong Guiyi Jue, nor can it increase its own strength, so it must be replaced.
Among a lot of incomplete memories of combat skills, Lu Chen found quite a few powerful combat skills.
The lowest is the Xuan level, and the highest is the Heaven level!
Tiangang Fist, a high-grade Xuan-level combat skill, lacks most of the memory and is of too low value to be used.
Taiyin Palm, a low-grade combat skill at the Earth level, lacks half of the memory, and is worth 50%, so it can be considered.
Nine-armed master, high-grade combat skills on the ground level, missing part of the memory, 60% value, can be considered.
Sky-cutting, a top-grade sword technique at the heaven level, lacks the memory of the last third of the sword. It is of high value and can be used in the future!
Broken Moon, a mid-level swordsmanship at the heavenly level, lacks a quarter of the memory behind it. It is of high value and can be used in the future!
Penetrating the Sun, a mid-level archery technique at the Heaven level, lacks the first third of the memory, is worthless, and cannot be used!
Any one of these combat skills, even if it is incomplete, can shock the entire Shuangmu City.
The highest combat skill in Shuangmu City is only a high-grade yellow grade skill, which is still in the collection of the city lord's palace. Other big families only have a middle-grade yellow grade skill.
Finally, a combat skill that still had 80% memory, attracted Lu Chen's attention.
Yanyang pointed out that the high-grade combat skills on the ground level lacked one-fifth of the memory behind them, and were worth 80%, so they can be used!
If it were a heaven-level combat skill, with Lu Chen's current cultivation level, he simply didn't have the strength to activate it.
As for the earth-level combat skills, they are probably too high, and even if they are forced to be used, it will be very difficult.
It is best to use Xuan level combat skills. Unfortunately, there are relatively few Xuan level combat skills, and there are not many suitable for Lu Chen.
Lu Chen had no choice but toI hope that the Nine Dragons Return to One Technique can activate this earth-level combat skill.
Otherwise, if you don't have a suitable combat skill and can't increase your strength, you will lose a lot of advantages.
